newsitem.title: UK: BTR to pay $60 mln for U.S. actuator unit.
newsitem.headline: BTR to pay $60 mln for U.S. actuator unit.

text.p: British conglomerate BTR Plc said on Tuesday its process control group had bought Limitorque Corporation from American Manufacturing Corporation for $60 million.
Limitorque, one of the largest electric actuator makers in the world, will join BTR's Process Control valve business, BTR said in a statement.
Based in Lynchburg, Virginia with annual sales of $76 million, the company has additional manufacturing operations in North Carolina, England, Australia, Singapore and India.

"Limitorque fits well with BTR's strategy of furthering the valve group's global presence, complementing its existing product range and enhancing its capability to offer integrated solutions to the international customer base," the company said.
